matchups.writeup: Statement made for the three piece. Two-time defending champion Globo Gym exploded for 197.70 pts—the highest opening week score in modern Y2K history—to blow out IRKed by 88.64 pts (biggest blowout of Week 1) and secure the opening Hot Start bounty. Ashton Jeanty (34.20), Brock Purdy (28.10), and Javonte Williams (22.70) powered a relentless 95.2% coaching efficiency attack. Mike's squad stumbled out of the gate at 109.06 pts with a costly 75.0% efficiency, leaving 36.38 pts on the pine (including Caleb Williams' 41.76 eruption) as Dylan knotted their all-time series at 9-9.
matchups.previewWriteup: Both OGs entering their 9th season in Y2K. Globo Gym: back-to-back champs (2024-2025), looking to make a three piece. IRKed: 2019 champion, top-4 in 2023 and 2024, looking to make it back to the postseason having just missed last season. Mike holds the slim 9-8 series edge, but Dylan took their Week 9 thriller last year by under a single point (141.31 to 140.42, making up the difference between 5th and 7th place for Jelqaida'25).

matchups.writeup: A heartbreaker in the clash of OGs. Casey survived the closest battle of the opening slate (+8.48 margin) to snatch the win 123.94 to 115.46, claiming Week 1's Luckiest Win badge as the lowest-scoring victor. The win exacted sweet revenge for Casey after Phillip's 1.33-pt victory in Wk14'25 clinched his #2 playoff seed. Phillip falls to 0-1 for just the *second time* in franchise history (claiming Week 1's Heartbreak badge), while AARPFL starts on the front foot despite leaving 37.12 pts on his bench.
matchups.previewWriteup: Another clash of OGs entering their 9th season. Ho Chi Win City is the gold standard of regular season excellence in Y2K, being the only franchise to never miss the postseason (8 for 8). Coming off a runner-up finish in 2025, the 2x champ looks to make it not only 9 consecutive top-4 finishes, but also gather his first chip in the modern era. AARPFL enters on a 3-year playoff run of his own, but will need to find a way to break through the first round having never won that crucial round 1 matchup. Phillip clinched his #2 seed bye week in 2025 with a Week 14 victory over Casey by just 1.33 points.

matchups.writeup: Game of the Week: The curse continues. Jasper remains Tess's inescapable kryptonite, extending his regular season dominance to 4-0 (5-0 all-time including the W17'25 bronze showdown) with a 128.22 to 108.66 triumph. Tess executed near-flawless 99.4% coaching efficiency, but was done in by the league's lowest scoring output of opening week. Blue's Balls once again defies the metrics, banking a win despite a 78.9% coaching efficiency to open 1-0.
matchups.previewWriteup: Game of the Week: A rematch of last year's 3rd place game. Blue's Balls enters his 5th season holding the 2nd-highest career winning percentage in league history (57.1%) despite ranking **2nd-to-last** in OVR_W-L(!); he rode a record 7 lucky wins to a 3rd place finish in 2025. Tess Finesse enters her 3rd season with a .500 record and a playoff win under her belt (leaving Bo as the only active manager without one, despite 4 appearances in 5 years...). Jasper has been Tess's ultimate nemesis, going 3-0 in regular season meetings and defeating her in W17'25 to take the bronze.

matchups.writeup: A thunderous entrance to the Y2K arena. Darnold Schwarzenegger delivered one of the most emphatic debuts in league history, dropping 180.56 pts behind drafted blue-chippers Bijan (1.1), Lamar (4.48), and Aubrey (9.97). The rookie powerhouse overpowered the reigning 2025 Scoring Champion by 67.36 pts, leaving Gl Hf shellshocked at 113.20 pts. Trace's campaign to notch back-to-back playoff berths for the first time *ever* starts in an 0-1 hole, while Alex instantly asserts himself as a tier-1 title contender.
matchups.previewWriteup: An OG champion welcomes the newest face to Y2K. Trace enters his 9th season as a former champion (2022) and reigning 2025 Scoring Champion (2,139 PF), looking to secure back-to-back postseason trips for the first time *ever*. Darnold Schwarzenegger makes his official Y2K league debut, stacking his lineup with top-tier talent: Bijan (1.1), McBride (2.24), Lamar (4.48), LAR (7.73), and Aubrey (9.97).

matchups.writeup: Self-inflicted heartbreak and a franchise-defining blunder. Donkey Squad entered looking to extend a 3-game streak over Bo, but Ryan suffered the Toughest Loss of Week 1 (131.56 pts) compounded by a catastrophic D'Oh! blunder: starting Joe Burrow (12.66) while benching Josh Allen (39.66). The +27.00 net blunder easily wiped out the 15.76 deficit that handed Aaron codger the 147.32 to 131.56 victory. Bo snaps his skid against RJ and banks a crucial opening win on his mission to snap his 0-4 postseason slump.
matchups.previewWriteup: The final OG, Donkey Squad, enters his 9th season looking to snap out of a prolonged slump. The 2021 champion and 4-time podium finisher has missed the postseason the last 3 years and finished in last place in 2025. If he misses the playoffs again this year, he'll tie the longest drought in Y2K history (Casey'19-22). Aaron codger comes into his 6th season after having his 4-year playoff streak snapped in 2025 with an 8th-place finish. He's determined to get back to the dance and finally secure his elusive first career postseason win (0-4 all-time). Ryan holds a 3-game winning streak against Bo after sweeping both meetings last season; they'll meet only this once this regular season.

matchups.writeup: The prodigal brother returns in dominant fashion. Back from his 2-year Roommate-Gate exile, Trenches cooper stormed the field with 168.60 pts and a clinical 96.4% coaching efficiency, pushing his lifetime edge over his brother to 4-1. Dustin's much-hyped redemption campaign hit an immediate roadblock at 115.80 pts, unable to keep pace with Coop's balanced assault. Cooper immediately resumes his status as the league's all-time managerial efficiency king.
matchups.previewWriteup: Dusty’s Dingleberries enters his 6th season looking for a major redemption campaign. Following back-to-back scoring titles, a 2023 championship, and a 2024 runner-up finish, Dustin cratered to 3-11 in 2025 after suffering a record-tying 5 D'Oh bench blunders (T1-Trace'23,RJ'25) and 5 heartbreak losses (T-Mike with 10 all-time). Trenches cooper returns to Y2K for his 3rd season after a 2-year hiatus. Cooper stunned the league in his 2022 rookie campaign with a run all the way to the championship game before being unceremoniously exiled in 2023 following Roommate-Gate. Cooper holds the 3-1 historical edge over his brother, though Dusty took their last meeting in late 2023. Coop's 97.8% all-time coaching efficiency is far and away the best in league history.

matchups.writeup: The three-piece train rolls on against a familiar punching bag. Dylan has never lost to Tess (*ever*), riding a 5-0 lifetime sweep including an emphatic 37.98-pt demolition in the 2025 Semifinals en route to his second ring. Globo Gym enters after detonating for 197.70 pts in Week 1—the highest opening week score in modern league history—to claim the Hot Start bounty. Tess executed a clinical 99.4% coaching efficiency in Week 1, but was crippled by the league's lowest scoring ceiling (108.66 pts). To avoid an 0-2 hole, Tess must pull off the biggest upset of the young season.

matchups.writeup: A high-stakes clash between the league's model of consistency and a resurging contender. Phillip enters reeling from an 8.48-pt heartbreak loss to Casey, marking only the *second time* in 9 seasons that Ho Chi Win City has opened 0-1. Bo banks a 1-0 start after taking advantage of Ryan's Week 1 D'Oh blunder, and now looks to avenge both his 2024 Wild Card elimination (161.16 to 144.38) and last season's 46-pt blowout. A win for Bo ties the lifetime series at 4-4 and sends Phillip to an unprecedented 0-2 start.

matchups.writeup: Clash of OGs with franchises hanging in the balance. Entering their 17th all-time regular season meeting, Trace and Ryan sit deadlocked at 8-8. Both squads fell in Week 1, meaning one of these founding titans is headed for a brutal 0-2 hole. Trace was bludgeoned by Alex's 180.56 debut barrage, while Ryan is recovering from the psychological trauma of benching Josh Allen (39.66 pts) for Joe Burrow (12.66 pts) in a winnable 15.76-pt loss to Bo. Trace swept both 2025 meetings while averaging a blistering 179.5 PPG against Donkey Squad; Ryan needs his QB anchor on the field to stop the skid.

matchups.writeup: Game of the Week: The ultimate playoff nemesis returns. Jasper has ended Casey's season in the Wild Card round in two of the last four years (2022 and 2025), building a dominant 5-game winning streak. Both managers enter 1-0 after surviving ugly Week 1 scraps: Casey captured the Luckiest Win badge (123.94 pts), while Jasper rode his trademark fortune to edge Tess with 128.22 pts. Casey hasn't defeated Blue's Balls since Week 10 of 2022; snapping this curse would give AARPFL his first 2-0 start since his 2023 playoff campaign.

Cooper announced his return from the 2-year Roommate-Gate exile with a vengeance in Week 1, posting 168.60 pts behind a league-leading 96.4% coaching efficiency. Mike, meanwhile, was on the receiving end of an 88.64-pt beating from Dylan, burdened by a 75.0% efficiency that left 36.38 pts on the bench (including Caleb Williams' 41.76 explosion). They split their two meetings across 2022-2023, but Coop's high-octane firepower makes this an urgent bounce-back test for the 2019 champion.
